text:
This is a "before eating" photo, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed the person eats everything, so leftover is 0.

The plate holds four sushi roll pieces (maki), one with avocado, one with a spicy tuna or salmon filling, and one with vegetables. Each piece is about 35-40 g, so the sushi is roughly 150 g. There is also a small portion of pickled ginger, a dab of wasabi, and green tea.

Energy for the sushi is about 150 g at 1.4 kcal/g, or roughly 210 kcal. The ginger adds about 5 kcal and the tea about 0.

That gives roughly 215 kcal served, with a macro split of about 7 g protein, 40 g carbohydrate and 3 g fat.
